Although arranging appointments can sometimes be difficult, this time the process was straightforward from start to finish.

The consultation with Dr Brown went smoothly, with sufficient time for discussion and for setting out an appropriate plan. A blood test was arranged for the same day, and the results were reported promptly, exactly as promised. The action plan was put in place using the resources available at the time.

Dr Brown also took the time to discuss a separate case involving another member of our family, which we had contacted the surgery about a few days earlier. This was very much appreciated.

Overall, it was a good experience.
